Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiConnectionCycleInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiConnectionCycleInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiConnectionCycleInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable evidence for one cyclic strongly connected group of explicit DEXPI material-connection endpoint references.

This record describes source-document graph evidence only. It does not establish hydraulic continuity, a physical recycle, process intent, or live ProcessSystem topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      Creates immutable directed-cycle source-reference evidence.
      Parameters:
      id - deterministic cycle-group evidence identity
      connectionComponentId - owning weak connection-component evidence identity
      endpointIds - endpoint identities in first-reference order

      outgoingBoundaryConnectionIds - connection-evidence identities leaving the cyclic group in source order
      unresolvedEndpointIds - endpoint identities that do not resolve in the source document
      selfReference - whether the group contains an explicit self-reference connection
